title: July 17, 2026
summary: Agents can now connect to Great Question on their own with a secure API token, seeing only what that user is permitted to see. Agents can also start from saved study templates instead of rebuilding screener questions by hand. Improvements: role-change errors now name the exact blocking reason (seat limits, permissions); calendar owners and study owners get an in-app warning with a link to the interview when Microsoft rejects an event for a full mailbox. Fixes: adding interview moderators by email now works for existing account members; creating a study via MCP without a team now assigns your default team automatically.
body_markdown:
Agents can now connect to Great Question on their own, give an agent a secure API token once, and it connects in the background whenever it needs to, without a human driving it. It only sees what that user is allowed to see, the same permissions and privacy as a normal login.


Agents can also start from your saved study templates instead of rebuilding every screener question by hand, with new tools to list, search, read, and apply templates.
